This is an ___ year old female transferred from ___ 
in ___ where she presented with left leg weakness following 
recent bilateral lower extremity PCI.

She was found to have 
increased lower extremity edema, in heart failure and an echo 
showing increased mitral regurgitation, increased tricuspid 
regurgitation and pulmonary hypertension showing a drop in her
EF.

She was treated with IV Lasix, however a discharge summary 
was not sent with the patient and details are currently lacking.
She was arranged for transfer to ___ for evaluation for
Mitraclip.

She reported heaviness and weakness of the left 
lower extremity since her procedure.

At home, she reports she 
generally wears her oxygen one-half to two liters all day and is 
able to do some chores around the house.

Conversation with her 
son reveals that ambulating to the kitchen has been a long 
standing difficulty for her.

She has not been active at 
baseline for some time.

Her FSBS have been running 190-280 at 
home on Meformin alone.

She had recent ulcerations open up in 
the left leg but these appear to have healed.

She denies any 
frank orthopnea or PND.

Her abdomen was noted to be a bit more 
swollen than usual and she denies any bleeding problems with 
aspirin or Plavix.
